rationale: The mass reads as a compact, slightly bent low-rise object, but the four views do not establish a robust public void, active street threshold, or convincing sectionally articulated neighborhood-building logic. It is coherent as a single object, so repair integrity is decent, but the dominant gesture is too box-like and too self-contained relative to the program brief. The blue access edge is not answered by a legible entry seam, court, or undercut; instead the object remains largely sealed. References suggest that this program benefits from a carved central public space, bridge/terrace relationships, and a more porous ground condition. The candidate therefore fails program_fit_hard_pass even though the silhouette is not chaotic.
